novelty_flags.label: thm:privacy-free-benchmark / related_work
novelty_flags.one_line: The core says KBRW's upper bound is inherited directly by the stated density-bounded law class, but its Theorem 2 retains conditions controlling covariate-distribution/Gram estimation and establishes matching attainment only on a contained density submodel.

soundness_flags.label: def:paired-cell-handle and all paired-cell statements
soundness_flags.one_line: The table kernel uses undefined functional notation t(x) although t is declared as a scalar, and reuses a0 both as the global information exponent and as the binary treatment-table argument; define a bump-valued t(·) and rename the table coordinate.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:matched-private-cate-phase / ass:delta-regime
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The claimed exact private frontier is restricted to the small-leakage regime delta_n <= c_delta epsilon_n; no claim is made for larger approximate-DP leakage.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Matched central-DP frontier conditional on 0 < epsilon_n <= 1 and 0 <= delta_n <= c_delta epsilon_n, c_delta <= 1/40.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: prop:catalogue-two-point-corollary
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The ordinary gamma-smooth private two-point limitation is imported from the existing catalogue rather than reproved by this project.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The new paired-mixture lower bound is conditional on the existing catalogue two-point branch for the ordinary private-regression term.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The higher-order local-polynomial attaining result retains conditions on nuisance and covariate-distribution/Gram estimation; Remark 10 identifies only a contained density class for the matching upper bound, and Remark 11 displays the residual third-order covariate-distribution error.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 3, Theorem 1, equation (4); p. 4, Theorem 3, equation (7).
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The private Le Cam and Assouad results use a supplied coupling with expected Hamming distance D and give a privacy term 0.9 exp(-10 epsilon D)-10 D delta.
The paper applies DP Assouad to bounded-second-moment mean estimation under delta <= epsilon; it is not a causal fuzzy-mixture result.

source_verification_receipts.locator: OpenReview publication landing page; PDF access returned an anti-bot interstitial.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the asserted direct KBRW inheritance with a proved inclusion from the present density class to KBRW's attainability conditions, or add the needed covariate-density and Gram-estimation hypotheses explicitly.
Make the paired-cell object literal: define the bump-valued t(x), distinguish the treatment-table input from exponent a0, and state the positivity/Hölder constants for the smooth lift.
Add a regime diagram or corollary identifying exactly when the q-private branch strictly dominates the ordinary gamma-private branch, with an explicit nonempty parameter example.

recommended_next_step: Revise the KBRW comparison and repair the paired-cell notation, then retain this field-tier matched private-minimax angle for Stage 0.
